ourStory.title: From one bench to thousands of families.
paragraphs: What started as a modest goldsmith's counter grew into a destination for bridal suites, temple jewellery, and bespoke heirlooms — without ever compromising on weight or purity.
Our karigars still file, set, and polish under the same roof where generations have shopped. Every commission is weighed twice: once at the bench, once at the counter.
Today we serve families across India with transparent pricing, live gold charts, and the same promise our founder made in 1984.

founder.heading: A goldsmith's son. A father's promise.
founder.quote: We don't sell jewellery. We hand over a piece of someone's wedding day, their daughter's first earrings, their grandmother's memory.
founder.description: Ramesh Agarwal opened a single bench in Bowbazar in 1984 with three karigars and one promise: every gram, weighed honestly. Forty years on, his sons run the same bench — and the same promise.
founder.name: Ramesh Agarwal
